Portrait Frame - Three-Quarter Body.description:
🖼️ Portrait Framing: Three-Quarter Body
The default: head through knees or mid-shins, showing most of the outfit and pose.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Portrait Frame - Three-Quarter Body.traitNarrativeEffects: Vertical three-quarter-body portrait from the top of the hair through below the knees or mid-shins. Show the complete head, torso, arms, hands, hips, thighs, knees, lower garment structure, and most of the pose. Keep the visible body fully inside the canvas with margin above the head and below the lowest visible leg point. Footwear is outside the crop unless naturally included without changing distance. Do not use face-only, chest-up, waist-up, thigh-up, or full head-to-toe framing.
